text:
sara (pm): Quick sync — we need to align the model-catalog onboarding pace with customer-driven asks and our benching cadence. Proposal: define 3 'pacing lanes' (fast / standard / delayed) that map to a bench-slice + migration runway. Who's in?

josh (eng): Sounds reasonable. Clarify: what exactly goes into the bench-slice? latency + quality + resource bucket?

vincent (ml): I'd keep it to 3 signals: embed recall (task-specific), gen-quality delta vs baseline (eval set), and tail latency (p99). Each lane sets thresholds on those.

casey (solutions): Important customer note: a couple of pilots asked for a freeze window during contract review — they want pin exceptions and a longer migration runway. We should bake that into the lanes (i.e., an "exception" flow).

liam (sales): From GTM: we can offer a 60-day migration credit + a staged canary for strategic customers. Need clear comm language and a list of eligible customers.

sara (pm): Decision proposal: adopt lanes + bench-slice gating. Action items: josh -> infra/canary hooks and shadow-serve plan; vincent -> formalize bench-slice definitions and pass/fail matrix; casey -> draft comms and pin-exception flow; liam -> pilot roster and customer asks. Can we commit to owners and rough ETA?

josh (eng): On infra: will need runtime canary hooks, a flag to shadow-serve under a routing policy, and observability for per-canary token-level costs. I can prototype the hooks + a minimal dashboard by next Tue.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: noted: please create ticket INF-9234 for canary hooks and link PRs.

vincent (ml): Bench slice draft (will push to the repo): recall >= 0.85 on target slice, gen-quality delta <= 0.05 (vs pinned baseline) on eval prompts, p99 latency <= 600ms (standard infra). I'll add an example evaluation script and sample slices.

casey (solutions): Comm draft idea: "soft pin" language — customers can opt into a pin for 2 weeks while we run their canary; after 60 days we auto-enroll unless they request extension. Will write copy + FAQ and share for legal.

liam (sales): I'll confirm pilot roster by EOD Thu and surface any customers that must be in a delayed lane because of procurement timelines.

sara (pm): Great. Meeting to sign off: Friday 10am PT. Please bring: bench-slice doc, infra prototype plan, comm draft, and pilot roster. Tagging @josh @vincent @casey @liam. :calendar: :thumbsup:

josh (eng): Works for me.

vincent (ml): I'll have the bench-slice PR ready for review before the meeting.

casey (solutions): I'll post the comm draft in #product-docs and add a short bullets doc for legal.

liam (sales): Confirming — roster update EOD Thu.

sara (pm): Thanks all — goal is to ship lane definitions + gating + comm in next sprint so onboarding teams have deterministic acceptance checks.
